implementation.previous_behavior: Language could issue and reuse a function-body fact when that function's declaration check failed.
implementation.current_behavior: Language issues and reuses a body fact only after accepting a current declaration fact or producing one after successful declaration validation.

regression.invalid_declaration: Function declares a storage read effect without declaring the required capability.
regression.before_fix: The first invalid validation returned one Verified body fact.
regression.after_fix: No body fact is issued; a caller-supplied fact with a matching current body basis is rejected with DeclarationInterfaceChanged and the body is checked again.
